description: Robot task construction, policy serving and viewer interaction
commands: uv run physicalview run robotics --action tasks --config configs/local.yaml --scene room --out outputs/scenes/room_factory
uv run physicalview run robotics --action policy-server --model pi05_droid_jointpos --config configs/local.yaml --where slurm --port 8000
inputs: Exported simulation, task targets and optional policy checkpoint
outputs: Tasks, action traces and explicit outcomes. Scripted reach/IK motion is not evidence of reliable manipulation.
